description: Import a Transept Strings corpus (.tstrings.json shape). Locales: explicit params win; with none named the corpus header target_locales apply (no locales anywhere → sync no_target_languages). A single-locale import is ONE version row carrying the corpus (language_group_id null until more locales join). Async: returns processing_job_id — poll processing_job_get. Translations the corpus carries land active and bill nothing.

document.description: The .tstrings.json corpus inline, e.g. {"format":"transept-strings","version":1,"source_locale":"en","units":[{"id":"auth.title","source":"Sign in"}]}. A unit may carry targets ({"de":"Anmelden"}), which land unbilled.

document_category.description: Category that tunes the prompts: general_document, legal, marketing or technical.

project_id.description: Project to file the document in (id from project_list).

target_language.description: The master version’s target language: a language code, e.g. "de" or "zh".

target_languages.description: Languages to produce, one version each: language codes, e.g. ["de", "fr"].

use_target_locales.description: With no languages passed, use the corpus header’s target_locales.

name: strings_import
title: Import strings corpus
